messages:
sophia: Dropping a thread about sampling indicators across heatmap & p95 hover. I sketched three badge treatments in figma: compact pill, inline icon+abbr, and full sentence tooltip. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc
noah: quick ask: do we show badge only on hover or always visible?
sophia: proposal: always-visible micro-pill when sampling > 0. But change color/CTA when sample rate low. Hover reveals full sentence and recommended action.
tanya: for heatmap tiles we can't show pill per-cell. maybe global header pill + a subtle dot on tiles with very low sample.
kevin: agree on global pill. For scrubber/p95 preview, show a small confidence band behind the value: p95 ± delta (light stroke). Value text gets a small pill saying "Sampled".
rachel: copy nits: use "Sampled estimate" not just "Sampled". Users misread otherwise.
sophia: noted. Also thinking about badge states: greenish neutral for >20%: "Sampled estimate"; amber for 5-20%: "Low sample"; red for <5%: "Very low sample" + tooltip: "Data based on very small sample  may be unreliable".
noah: tiny accessibility thing: color alone shouldn't indicate severity. add an icon (exclamation) for amber/red and sr-only text.
tanya: keyboard behavior: pill should be tabbable; hitting enter opens tooltip/dialog with details and a small link: "Request recalculation" (calls backend).
kevin: backend note: we can return both raw_sample and bootstrapped_ci fields. ui should render ci if present: show line + translucent fill, and annotate upper/lower values in tooltip.
rachel: microcopy for tooltip: "Based on X% of requests. Confidence interval: [lower ms] - [upper ms]." Short alt: "X% sample, low confidence."
sophia: analytics: fire event ui.latency.sample_badge_view with properties {sample_rate, badge_state}. kevin can you add?
kevin: will add. event name: ui.latency.sample_badge_view. Payload: sample_rate (float), badge_level ("ok"|"low"|"very_low"), view_source ("heatmap"|"scrubber"|"header").
noah: UX question: when user increases time-range (e.g., 1h -> 7d), sample rate may change. Should we animate badge color change or show an inline toast explaining variance?
tanya: prefer subtle transform: fade pill color + small caret tooltip: "Sample rate changed to X% for this range". Avoid full toast.
rachel: accessibility: ensure aria-live polite announces sample rate change when badge updates during keyboard navigation. Also include role="status" region for CI updates.
sophia: design constraint: avoid overlapping UI in narrow widths. For mobile, collapse pill into the header overflow menu and show an icon next to the chart title.
kevin: dev note: throttle updates to badge to 500ms when range drag happens. Don't hit backend on every move.
noah: we should also surface a help link in the tooltip: "What does sample mean?" linking to docs.
tanya: doc blurb: "Sampling reduces query cost by returning metrics from a subset of requests. Use the adjust range or request recalculation for full aggregates." rachel can you draft doc copy?
rachel: on it. will post variants shortly.
uxbot: Reminder: run copy + a11y pass after design sign-off.
sophia: next actions: rachel drafts tooltip/doc copy; kevin implements analytics + UI stub; tanya prototypes keyboard flow in figma; noah to review mobile collapse. Reconvene tomorrow in sync.
